title: CLI Governance Guard Evidence Integration v1

changes: Added GovernedExecution dataclass with decision, can_execute, evidence_status, evidence_ref fields
Updated emit_structured_result() to accept can_execute, evidence_ref, evidence_status optional fields

scripts_touched.changes: Uses require_governed_execution_with_evidence(). Added _handle_governed_mutation(), _emit_executed_result() helpers. Evidence fields in --json output.
Uses require_governed_execution_with_evidence(). Evidence fields in blocked/error JSON output.
Uses require_governed_execution_with_evidence(). Evidence fields in blocked JSON output.
No changes — no governance gating needed (no_live_network by design).

evidence_persistence_behavior.execute_read_only: Governance evaluated but evidence optional. can_execute=True even without persistence.
evidence_persistence_behavior.execute_mutation_with_store: Governance evaluated + decision persisted as ReceiptEnvelope. evidence_status=persisted. evidence_ref=envelope_id. can_execute=True.
evidence_persistence_behavior.execute_mutation_without_store: Governance evaluated but cannot persist. evidence_status=persistence_failed. can_execute=False (fail-closed for mutation/admin tiers).
evidence_persistence_behavior.execute_blocked_by_governance: Decision not persisted because execution is blocked. evidence_status=not_persisted. can_execute=False.

fail_closed_behavior.when: execute_requested=True AND authority_tier in {local_mutation, remote_mutation, admin_configuration} AND evidence persistence fails (no ReceiptStore or store.append() fails)
fail_closed_behavior.result: GovernedExecution.can_execute=False. evidence_status='persistence_failed'. Script must NOT execute the mutation.
fail_closed_behavior.rationale: Mutation-capable operations require durable evidence trace for auditability. If the trace cannot be created, the operation must be blocked (fail-closed).

json_fields_added.can_execute: boolean — True if the mutation may proceed
json_fields_added.evidence_ref: string | null — Receipt envelope_id if persisted
